newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates airline undecided on Boeing 777 options.
newsitem.headline: Emirates airline undecided on Boeing 777 options.

text.p: Dubai government-owned Emirates airline has not decided whether to turn options to buy seven Boeing 777s into firm orders, an official said in remarks published on Saturday.

"We have not yet decided to sign the second part of the contract that gives Emirates airline the right to buy seven additional 777s," Emirates Group managing director Maurice Flanagan told al-Khaleej newspaper.
But he added: "The option is still open and Boeing understands our delay in making a decision and is not pressuring us to make any decision."
Emirates Group is made up of Emirates airline and Dubai airport handler and travel management company DNATA. Dubai is one of seven emirates forming the Gulf state of United Arab Emirates.
Emirates airline in October took delivery of its third Boeing 777. It has another four 777s on order and an option for seven more.
